limitation: Only the three documents of the separate fixture application are managed. Fractional layouts verify live AX geometry, visibility and focus, not delivery or acceptance of drag payloads. ScreenCaptureKit pixel output is checked only if permission was already granted; visual correspondence, other applications, content preservation and hardware shortcut delivery are outside this test. No system permission is requested.

switchPerformance.measurement: Monotonic elapsed time from select() to completed presentation with confirmed system-wide AX keyboard focus, including bounded outgoing snapshot preparation, focus handoff, page-turn animation when enabled, diagnostic polling, and AX readback. Successful switches only; no fixed cross-application latency pass/fail budget.
